name: Pan-Fried Pork Sausage & Warm Broccoli Caesar with Crispy Bread Crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 crowns broccoli
extra virgin olive oil
salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until broccoli is golden brown and tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for next step.)

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels. Return to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
4 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Transfer to another small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Mince anchovy fillets. Add both to the bowl with the Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
2 anchovy fillets, packed in oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl. Add mayo, oil, pepper, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
2 tbsp mayonnaise
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp black pepper
salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide sausages and broccoli between plates. Drizzle broccoli with dressing and top with crispy bread crumbs. Enjoy!
